items.title: Get form messages by email
items.detail: 4 form(s) came across. Messages are kept in OpenSpace; choose where to get an email when someone writes.

items.title: Bring your newsletter subscribers
items.detail: Sign-up forms came across, but subscribers stay with Framer. Export them there and import them here.

items.title: Use prosper.love for your new site
items.detail: Your new site is live on a free address. When you're happy with it, we'll help you point prosper.love at it — your old site keeps working until then.

items.title: Use your own font licence
items.detail: Your old site used Geograph Regular and Geograph Medium, which we're not allowed to copy, so the closest free fonts stand in (Instrument Sans, Proza Libre). If you have a web licence, download the font files (WOFF2) from the font service and upload them in Site Styles → Your fonts — they're stored in media/fonts/ — then choose them for your headings and text.
